title: Just Intonation
description: Simple whole-number ratios used as musical intervals and chords.

lab.label: Lab
lab.prompt: Try mapping simple ratios onto a scale.

choices.text: Its frequency relationship can be described by a simple whole-number ratio.
It always equals one step in 12-EDO.
It is generated only by stacked perfect fifths.

items.title: Create a JI scale
items.body: Choose a root and build a scale from just-intonation ratios.

items.title: Find a chord in a JI scale
items.body: Pick three or more notes from your JI scale and describe the ratios they form above the root.

items.title: Make a melody in a JI scale
items.body: Use notes from your JI scale to write a short melody that emphasizes one or two clear ratios.
